title: Aspen Search two-row footer
description: A footer on the hairline grid. Top row: a 38px tagline, stacked links, thin live clock faces for two cities, and email / outbound cells where an ink fill rises on hover. Bottom row: an ink panel with a big plain wordmark and a mono legal line, beside a mint call-to-action panel with a huge hairline arrow. On desktop the bottom row stays pinned to the window's foot while the top row slides up over it.
notes: needs JavaScript only for the live clocks (static HTML shows the fallback times)
the sticky reveal is CSS position: sticky, desktop only
the wordmark is plain text in the display face; pass a logo to sit above it
